# The Quiet Ones

*The carters and small traders who used to sit quietly at the back of the Open Table are out on the Walkers' Road, waiting on caravans the boars keep stopping. Thin the bristle boars and ironhide hogs of the Bristlewood so they can come home and be heard.*
